llm_response.reason: The domain 'lexieramirez.shop' falsely claims to be the official SCHIESSER online shop, despite not matching the legitimate brand's domain (schiesser.com). The website provides no clear business or company information and appears to spoof the official SCHIESSER branding and product selection—classic signs of a fake online shopping scam. Absence of transparent contact details and the use of an unrelated domain name both increase suspicion of fraudulent activity.
